method: stylesheet rule read in the T3 preview tab. prefers-reduced-motion was not emulated, so the page verdict comes from authored rules, not a second computed pass.

computedAtRest.button: transform 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), plus translate, scale and rotate at the same duration. animation-name none.

reducedMotionRules: .ur-sm-fade rules set animation none and mask-image none
sonner toast rules set transition none and animation none
